fields.label: Flight controller rotation
fields.hint: How the board is turned relative to the airframe, when its arrow does not point forward or it is mounted upside down.

orientation.hint: Set the rotation before calibrating. The accelerometer and compass calibrations are measured through it, so changing it later means calibrating both again, and the level horizon too. It takes effect after a reboot.

positions.label: Flight controller
positions.hint: Where the IMU sits. Keep it close to the centre of gravity: every centimetre off it adds acceleration from turning to what the accelerometer measures.

positions.label: GPS antenna
positions.hint: The antenna, not the receiver box. With RTK the offset is larger than the position error, so measure it.

PX4 v1.16.position_hint: Metres from the centre of gravity. Forward, right and down are positive, so a GPS on a mast above the frame has a negative Z.

positions.hint: Where the IMUs sit. Every IMU of the board that shares the first one's position is written with it. Keep the board close to the centre of gravity: every centimetre off it adds acceleration from turning to what the accelerometer measures.

positions.label: GPS antenna
positions.hint: The antenna, not the receiver box. With RTK the offset is larger than the position error, so measure it.

cases.position_hint: Metres from the centre of gravity. Forward, right and down are positive, so a GPS on a mast above the frame has a negative Z.

fields.label: Flight controller rotation
fields.hint: How the board is turned relative to the airframe, when its arrow does not point forward or it is mounted upside down.

fields.label: Pitch trim
fields.hint: The level calibration sets both trims. 0.1745 rad is 10°, the most ArduPilot accepts: anything larger is a rotation.
